description: This file defines a JavaScript class CKEDITOR.htmlParser for parsing HTML text, including handling tags, comments, CDATA sections, and text nodes. It provides overridable callback methods for processing different parts of HTML during parsing.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser
classes.description: A class for parsing HTML strings, with callback methods for handling tags, text, comments, and CDATA sections.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an HTML string, triggering callback methods for tags, text, comments, and CDATA sections.
